Charming Lobby

Sterile.

Charming Lobby is a political action that calls the first referendum CE

It is.

And a retainer is an action card, but that doesn't make The Summoning
a retainer.

Charming Lobby is not a Political Action card.

You can tell because political action cards have the political action
card icon up near the action card icon, and Charming Lobby doesn't
have that icon.

> sorry, but i read the rulings and links, (only about 3 links deep i
> must admit)
>
> and this looks like a decision by fiat. Which is fine, but is not the
> same as saying that it is not a political action. As the card text
> quite clearly state that it is a political action. And it is a card.
> So where is the disconnect?

It is not a "political action card" although it is an "action card"
and the action it grants is a "political action".

Political Action Card : Political Action :: Retainer Card : Employ
Retainer Action

Try replacing all instances of "political action card" with
"Referendum Card" (but leave "political action" as it is in other
cases) to get the idea (parallel to "retainer card" and "employ
action")
